meta.name: executing-plans
meta.description: Use when executing an implementation plan in the current session as the implementer yourself — your human partner chose inline execution, or no subagent tool is available

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按写好的实施计划一步步把方案落地成可运行的代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里已有一份写好的实施计划,准备自己动手把它实现
copy.tagline_en: Turn a written implementation plan into working code, step by step
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you already have a written plan and want to implement it yourself.

howto.what: Claude 在当前会话里自己按计划逐条实现代码:每个任务先写会失败的测试再让它通过,把进度和裁决写进台账文件;全部任务完成后对整条分支做一次代码审查。
howto.when: 当你有实现计划并选择内联执行(不为每个任务派子代理),或你的环境没有子代理工具可用时触发;任务大多相互独立时也适用。

say.text: 按这份计划在当前会话里逐任务实现
say.note: 它会建工作区和台账,从任务 1 开始

say.text: 任务 N 的输出和计划的 Expected 不一致,你裁决并记进台账
say.note: 它会记录 Ruling 后继续执行

say.text: 整条分支做完了,跑一次最终审查
say.note: 有子代理就派子代理,没有就自审

howto.what_en: Claude implements the plan itself in this session, task by task: it writes a failing test first, makes it pass, records progress and rulings in a ledger file, then runs one whole-branch review at the end.
howto.when_en: Use when you have an implementation plan and chose inline execution (no per-task subagents), or your environment has no subagent tool available; also when tasks are mostly independent.

say_en.text: Implement this plan yourself in this session, task by task
say_en.note: It sets up a workspace and ledger, starts at task 1

say_en.text: Task N's output doesn't match the plan's Expected — rule on it and log it
say_en.note: It records a Ruling and keeps going

say_en.text: The whole branch is done — run the final review
say_en.note: Dispatches a subagent if available, else self-reviews
